question:
The given table represents the sales figures of physics and chemistry books in the years 2003, 2004, 2005 and 2006.

 
 

 Year
 2003
 2004
 2005
 2006
 
 

 Physics
 300
 425
 475
 515
 
 

 Chemistry
 450
 550
 590
 700
 
 

In which year was the difference in the sale of the two subject books the least?
solution:
**Given:**

 
 

 Year
 2003
 2004
 2005
 2006
 
 

 Physics
 300
 425
 475
 515
 
 

 Chemistry
 450
 550
 590
 700
 
 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Difference in the sales of the two subject books for the year 2003 = 450 – 300 = 150

⇒ Difference in the sales of the two subject books for the year 2004 = 550 – 425 = 125

⇒ Difference in the sales of the two subject books for the year 2005 = 590 – 475 = 115

⇒ Difference in the sales of the two subject books for the year 2006 = 700 – 515 = 185

**Therefore, the difference in the sale of the two subject books is least in the year of 2005.**
